COMPUTATION / GUIDED READING
STAGE 01 / 10先去颅骨并配准到共同模板，再缩放与标准化。解剖位置、体素网格和强度空间决定后续表征的可比性。Skull stripping and atlas registration precede resizing and normalization, aligning anatomy, voxel grids and intensity space.
01
对齐三维输入Align the 3D input
先去颅骨并配准到共同模板，再缩放与标准化。解剖位置、体素网格和强度空间决定后续表征的可比性。Skull stripping and atlas registration precede resizing and normalization, aligning anatomy, voxel grids and intensity space.
02
划分三维体块Embed 3D patches
8×8×8 非重叠体块将 128³ 体积化为 4096 个位置。作者用核与步长均为 8 的 Conv3d 投影到 768 维，并加入三维位置编码。An 8³ patch grid creates 4096 positions. A stride-8 Conv3d projects patches to 768 dimensions with 3D positional encoding.
03
随机遮蔽 75%Mask 75% at random
预训练仅保留 1024 个可见体块，加入 CLS 标记后送入编码器。原始顺序索引用于解码阶段恢复位置。Pretraining retains 1024 visible patches plus CLS. Stored indices restore original positions during decoding.
04
编码可见上下文Encode visible context
基础模型使用 12 层、12 头 ViT。自注意力联合建模可见体块，编码器不接收被遮蔽位置的占位标记。The base model uses twelve ViT layers and twelve heads, attending over visible patches without masked-position placeholders.
05
恢复完整位置Restore the full grid
将编码结果投影到 512 维，补入共享可学习遮蔽标记，按 ids_restore 还原 4096 个体块位置并加入解码位置编码。Project to width 512, insert learned mask tokens and use ids_restore to recover all 4096 positions.
06
重建体块体素Reconstruct patch voxels
8 层、16 头解码器处理完整体块序列；线性预测头为每块输出 512 个体素值。目标是标准化强度空间中的重建。An eight-layer, sixteen-head decoder and linear head predict 512 normalized voxel values per patch.
07
只在遮蔽处计分Score masked patches only
按体块求体素均方误差，再只对遮蔽位置求平均。可见体块提供上下文，却不进入这一遮蔽重建损失的分母。Average voxel MSE per patch, then average only masked positions. Visible patches provide context without entering that denominator.
08
完整输入提取嵌入Extract a full-input embedding
表征推理关闭遮蔽。作者 inference.py 执行 forward_encoder(mask_ratio=0.0)，再读取 features[:,0,:]，得到基础模型的 768 维 CLS 表征。Inference disables masking and selects features[:,0,:] from forward_encoder: the base model’s 768-dimensional CLS representation.
09
选择下游学习方式Choose a transfer route
冻结编码器后训练 SVM／SVR，或用预训练参数初始化 ViT 再微调。两条路线的训练对象、输出与评价协议分别记录。Train SVM/SVR models on frozen embeddings, or initialize and fine-tune a ViT. These routes have separate objectives and evaluation protocols.
10
检查解剖解释Examine anatomical interpretation
论文结合注意力、区域体积相关性与潜变量操纵。解码后的区域变化可帮助研究表征；相关性、注意力与预测因果机制需分别理解。The paper combines attention, regional correlations and latent manipulation. Reconstructed changes aid interpretation while these forms of evidence remain distinct.
上一代瓶颈
  • 标注有限的三维 MRI 任务难以逐个从头训练，预设区域体积又只覆盖特定解剖描述。
  • Limited labels impede task-by-task 3D MRI training; predefined regional volumes cover selected anatomical descriptions.
核心想法
  • 从遮蔽体块重建学习三维结构，再把编码器迁移到脑龄与分类任务。
  • Learn 3D structure by reconstructing masked patches, then transfer the encoder to brain age and classification.
关键改进
  • 用稀疏可见体块训练重型编码器，以完整序列训练较轻解码器；下游表征关闭遮蔽。
  • Train a heavy encoder on visible patches and a lighter decoder on the complete sequence; disable masking for embeddings.
医学适配
  • 统一预处理后的 T1 脑 MRI，支持冻结嵌入和编码器微调两条路线。
  • Standardized T1 brain MRI supports frozen features and encoder fine-tuning.
适用范围与证据
  • 2026-10-20 首次公开的预印本；本页核对基础模型与固定作者实现，重建质量和下游预测分别解释。
  • Preprint first posted 2026-10-20. The base model and pinned implementation are checked; reconstruction and downstream prediction are evaluated separately.

设计原理与训练Design and training

  • 三维体块的 512 个体素先被投影到 768 维；特征宽度与空间体块大小是两个参数。A patch contains 512 voxels before projection to width 768; spatial patch size and feature width are separate parameters.
  • 75% 是预训练的体块遮蔽比例。4096 个空间位置保留 1024 个可见体块，再加入 CLS；提取嵌入时使用完整输入。The 75% masking ratio belongs to pretraining: 1024 of 4096 patches remain, plus CLS. Embedding extraction uses the complete input.
  • 编码器仅处理可见体块；解码器补齐遮蔽标记并恢复位置。两者的序列长度、宽度和计算责任不同。The encoder sees visible patches; the decoder inserts placeholders and restores positions, with different lengths and widths.
  • 三维正弦余弦位置编码保留各轴空间信息；重排后的体块必须按位置索引恢复。Three-dimensional sinusoidal positions retain axis information; shuffled patches must return to their indexed locations.
  • 损失先平均每块的体素误差，再对遮蔽块求平均。输入已标准化，重建值属于该强度空间。Voxel error is averaged within each patch and then across masked patches in normalized intensity space.
  • 基础模型的编码器为 12 层、768 维；代码也提供 large 与 huge 构造器，本页参数固定在论文基础模型。This page fixes the paper’s base encoder at twelve layers and width 768, distinguishing the additional large and huge code constructors.
  • 下游 SVM／SVR 消费冻结嵌入；ViT 微调则更新相应网络参数。冻结路线和微调路线应分别配置训练、验证与测试。Frozen SVM/SVR features and ViT fine-tuning require separate train, validation and test configurations.
  • 注意力可显示关注区域，区域相关性连接解剖描述，潜变量操纵考察解码变化；三类分析共同帮助理解表征。Attention, regional correlations and latent manipulation offer complementary views of learned representations.
  • 作者讨论了训练数据偏向特定研究和较年长人群的问题。外部队列、扫描协议和年龄覆盖是迁移评估的重要部分。Study composition, older participant coverage and acquisition protocols matter when evaluating transfer to external cohorts.

医学用途与适用范围Medical use and scope

  • 输入核对：检查去颅骨、配准方向、128³ 网格与强度标准化，再比较同一编码器的嵌入。Input checks: verify skull stripping, registration, the 128³ grid and normalization before comparing embeddings.
  • 脑龄回归：区分冻结嵌入加 SVR 与微调 ViT，分别报告年龄覆盖、误差和独立队列表现。Brain age: distinguish frozen-feature SVR from fine-tuned ViT; report age coverage and external-cohort error.
  • 分类应用：疾病与风险因素标签各有定义；判别分数、阈值、召回率和精确率一同阅读。Classification: read task definitions, thresholds, recall and precision alongside discrimination scores.
  • 研究划分：纵向扫描按参与者分组；预训练、下游训练及外部验证的数据角色分别记录。Study splits: group longitudinal scans by participant and record pretraining, downstream and external-validation roles.
  • 解释实验：区域体积与潜变量的相关性可供研究，潜变量改变后的重建不作为患者病程模拟。Interpretation: regional correlations and reconstructed latent changes are research analyses, rather than patient-trajectory simulations.
  • 发布使用：原论文图按 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 完整展示；作者软件另遵循非商业协议。本站的真实推理演示仍使用已批准的 ResNet-18。Reuse: the unmodified original uses CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; author software has separate noncommercial terms. The site’s approved real-inference demonstration remains ResNet-18.

原文核对与出处Primary-source notes

  1. 输入与体块Input and patches · E1

    论文第 3.2 节固定 128³ 输入与 8³ 体块；作者 PatchEmbedding 使用单通道 Conv3d。Section 3.2 fixes 128³ input and 8³ patches; PatchEmbedding uses single-channel Conv3d.

  2. 非对称结构Asymmetric architecture · E1

    基础编码器 12 层、768 维，解码器 8 层、512 维，分别使用 12 与 16 个注意力头。The base encoder has twelve layers at width 768; the decoder has eight at width 512, with twelve and sixteen heads.

    查看原文位置View source location ↗
  3. 重建目标Reconstruction objective · E1

    公式 1 与 forward_loss 只对遮蔽体块平均重建误差。Equation 1 and forward_loss average reconstruction error over masked patches only.

    查看原文位置View source location ↗
  4. 表征提取Embedding extraction · E1

    作者 inference.py 关闭遮蔽并选择 CLS 位置，基础模型输出 768 维嵌入。Author inference.py disables masking and selects CLS for the base model’s 768-dimensional embedding.

    查看原文位置View source location ↗
  5. 迁移路线Transfer routes · E1

    论文分别评估编码器微调与冻结嵌入加轻量模型，使用脑龄及疾病／风险因素任务。The paper separates encoder fine-tuning from frozen-feature lightweight models for brain-age and classification tasks.
